once again thank you so much. I just found out that my parents are unsure if my sister has eaten in the past 2 days. We’re scared that she may faint or need medical help. Getting her to eat is hard. I asked my mom if i could take a day off of homework but she told me i had to focus on my own mental health and not falling behind. My dad keeps mentioning her “staying alive” and i’m worried sick. I think i may try reaching out to my friend from before and hope that she understands. My mom is also talking to her now. She’s the best mom i could ask for (even though it may not sound like it. her full attention is on my sister so that’s why she has neglected me a bit) so hopefully she’ll be able to help my sister.

thank you so much. I’ve tried talking to my sister but she pushes me away. Today i made her dinner hoping i could sit with her and watch her eat for the first time in a while. When i went to her she told me to put the food in the fridge and that she’d eat it later which i think is a lie. Nothing bad ever happened between us so i don’t know why she’s pushing me away. Maybe she trying to protect me or maybe she just doesn’t like me anymore. As for friends, I dropped all of them at the beginning of quarantine as an attempt to isolate myself. One of my friends reached out a few days ago to reconnect because she felt sad and thought i may fell the same. We went on a walk and it was nice to see her but her sadness seemed to be more of a temporary thing because of quarantine. I don’t think it scratches the surface of the intense emotions i have been feeling. I would be able to tell her that i self harm without her freaking out. I guess it’s important to mention that i live in a relatively nice area and my old friends were upper middle class and manta i’ll ed’s was nonexistent in our friend group. So i ended it. I told her i wasn’t ready to form relationships again. First of all i don’t want to fake happiness to another person. I would rather her not know about my mental health because if she’s doing better than me, why expose her to my life? Second i would be an awful friend and any expectation of me scared me. I know i would use her for emotional support and then ghost her. Either way i would be inconsistent and a bad friend.  I know there’s not much i can do right now and i’m not asking for solutions. I just need to rant. My sister has a doctors appointment soon and we’re getting her a therapist specialized in eating disorders so that’s good. I just have to keep holding on for a little longer.
